ai_summary.headline: Mali budgets 5.3% of its plan for MPC and has funded 18% of that line, while cash preference data is unverified.
ai_summary.narrative: Mali's 2026 HNRP requires $577.9m on FTS and has received $162.1m, about 28% [s1][s2]. The Multi-Purpose Cash line asks for $30.7m, 5.3% of requirements, and has received $5.5m, or 18% of the line [s1][s2]. That is a lower coverage rate than the plan overall, which suggests MPC is being squeezed rather than protected. The gDCF analysis reports a 90% cash preference, nationally standardised transfer value and 6% cluster cash commitments, but I could not open the HNRP or the study behind them, so these remain unverified [s7]. Coordination exists through a CWG with a dashboard and a finalised post-distribution monitoring tool [s8], yet market monitoring is thin: only 145 of 445 markets were monitored in 2024, with large gaps in the north [s4], although a December 2025 joint monitoring round covered 21 markets [s6]. Total CVA across clusters is likely larger than the MPC line but is not aggregated.
barriers: MPC coverage (18%) is below overall plan coverage (28%)
Market monitoring gaps in the north
opportunities: Existing CWG tools and ICSM monitoring
Cluster commitments to cash could be tracked

total_funding_usd.note: All incoming funding to the plan, pledges excluded. Matches the FTS plan summary.

mpc_usd.note: FTS single-cluster view of the Transfert d’espèces à usages multiples cluster; shared-cluster view US$5.5M. Incoming flows, pledges excluded.

ctp_usd.note: All flows tagged 'Cash transfer programming (CTP)', inside or outside the MPC cluster.

sectoral_cva_usd.note: Flows whose FTS modality field is 'Cash transfer programming (CTP)' and whose destination cluster is not multi-purpose cash: 46 flows. The CTP tag is set by the reporting donor or agency and is not applied consistently, so this is a floor, not a measure of sectoral cash. Largest: Sécurité alimentaire US$8.9M, Protection US$3.8M, Abris/Biens Non Alimentaires US$3.1M.

cva_usd.note: Union of the MPC cluster and the CTP tag. Widest defensible FTS cash figure; still a floor because untagged sectoral cash is invisible.

cva_pct_of_total.note: cva_usd as a share of total plan funding.

sectoral_cva_pct_of_total.note: sectoral_cva_usd as a share of total plan funding.

mpc_pct_of_total.note: MPC cluster funding as a share of total plan funding (single-cluster view).

fts_cva.caveat: FTS records funding, not transfers to people, and only to first-level recipients. Sectoral cash depends on a modality tag that reporters apply unevenly.
